_comment: A heal_aura that heals the ally with the lowest health within a 1.5-unit radius plus 0.0444 per level, 12 HP plus 2.6667 per level, reapplying every 80 ticks; the cost drops slightly per level. The cost is billed per application, so the cadence sets the bill rate as much as the heal rate. All values placeholder.
